name: Email Verification Resend Success
summary: An unverified durable user receives a verification code, has a rejected attempt, requests a replacement code after cooldown, and successfully verifies the email address with the new proof.
finalOutcome: Email ownership is verified using the fresh proof issued by an accepted resend request.

sourceReferences.note: Representative resend behavior documents the start-to-end story while every listed scenario remains a single independently runnable UI action.
